name: Clean fresher answer with capstone, projects, availability

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Tell me about yourself and your strongest academic project.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I'm a final-year BTech student with CGPA 8.6. My capstone project was a real-time traffic-signal optimizer using reinforcement learning. I built the simulation environment, implemented the Q-learning agent in Python, and deployed it on a Raspberry Pi for the demo. We reduced average wait time by 18% in the simulation.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: What other projects have you worked on?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: I built a college bus-tracking app — implemented the backend in Node.js and integrated Google Maps. It's used by 400 students in my college daily. Also published a paper on the capstone project at a regional IEEE conference.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: My final exams end in May. I'm available to join from June 15 — that gives me time to wrap up my graduation formalities. I'm flexible on joining date if needed.
